messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated reserved pool 'resv-pool-3' CPU/GPU saturation detected. Reserved GPUs at 100% for 6m. Queue length rising: 120 -> 420 in 5m. Throttles applied. Paging oncall: @oncall-sre. Link: https://console.redwood.internal/incidents/3778884444

oncall-sre: I'm awake, looking. Any customer experiencing errors?

miguel: seeing elevated 429s for some tenants, but most 5xx are timeouts on the worker side. Northbridge (enterprise) has long tail queue growth.

shreya: noisy neighbor suspected — one tenant has spiked sustained batch jobs, pinned reservations. Confirming which reservation.

ops-bot: autoscaler event: failed to scale beyond cap=10 due to quota check. Policy: reserved-pool max_nodes=10. Attempts: 3, last_error: "quota_exceeded"

oncall-sre: ok that's the root cause. Can't autoscale because of reservation cap. We need an immediate mitigation plan: temporary evict or throttle heavy sessions, and coordinate with platform to bump cap for the pool.

miguel: @sam-platform can you temporarily bump pool cap or add emergency capacity from flex pool? If not, we should evict non-enterprise sessions.

sam-platform: joining. I can open a hot-ticket to infra to convert 2 flex nodes to this resv pool in ~12m. Quick option: apply per-tenant rate-limits on noisy sessions. I have a script to identify top sessions: `redwoodctl sessions top --pool resv-pool-3 --sort tokens --limit 50`

shreya: running that now. output snippet: ```
# redwoodctl sessions top --pool resv-pool-3
rank  tenant         sessions  in_flight_tokens
1     tenant-qx      18        48000
2     northbridge    7         22000
3     tenant-ark     3         12000
```

oncall-sre: tenant-qx looks like the noisy neighbor. Is tenant-qx an enterprise/reserved customer?

tara-cs: tenant-qx is a legacy partner on reserved but not SLA enterprise. Northbridge is enterprise, flagged for priority. We should protect Northbridge.

miguel: propose: 1) immediate soft-evict of low-priority tenant-qx long-lived sessions (drop idle > 60s). 2) apply short-term stricter token rate-limit for tenant-qx: `rate_limit.tokens=16/s`. 3) open hot-reserve for +2 GPUs from flex pool. 4) notify affected tenants.

oncall-sre: doing (1) now: `redwoodctl sessions evict --pool resv-pool-3 --tenant tenant-qx --idle-threshold 60`

ops-bot: eviction job started (job_id=evict-377888-01). Progress: 0/18 -> 12/18 evicted in 45s.

shreya: applying rate-limit on tenant-qx: `redwoodctl policies set --tenant tenant-qx --policy rate_limit.tokens=16` — applied.

sam-platform: I opened hot-ticket to infra request INF-5423 to convert 2 flex GPUs into resv-pool-3. ETA ~11m. Also requesting temporary bump of pool.max_nodes to 12 — pending approval.

miguel: notifying Northbridge: "we're actively mitigating capacity issues and prioritizing your sessions; possible transient throttling. Will update in 15m."

tara-cs: Northbridge replied: "seeing degraded throughput, thanks for the heads up. Any ETA?"

oncall-sre: ETA ~12-15m for extra nodes. If infra can't, fallback is to route Northbridge to a compatible model variant on dedicated-hosted fallback (lower capacity but isolated). Need product agreement.

sam-platform: infra accepted hot-ticket, but we need to run a quick health-check after nodes join. I'll watch autoscaler logs.

ops-bot: infra event: nodes_added=2 -> nodes_total=12 at ts=3778889800. Autoscaler reconciled.

shreya: queue length dropping: 420 -> 150 after evictions/rate-limits -> 60 after new nodes. 429 rate for Northbridge decreased. Logs: ```
2026-03-15T03:10:02Z pool=resv-pool-3 queue=150 inflight=320
2026-03-15T03:17:30Z pool=resv-pool-3 queue=60 inflight=180
```

miguel: good. Confirming Northbridge calls now show success and latency improved.

tara-cs: Northbridge: "thanks, looks stable. We'll monitor and let you know if anything else shows up."

oncall-sre: follow-ups: 1) create a ticket to revisit pool max_nodes limits and emergency quota flow so autoscaler can override under fast-approval flows. 2) add detection rule for sustained per-tenant tokens > 30k over 5m. 3) update runbook to include eviction + hot-reserve steps used here.

sam-platform: I'll own the emergency quota flow (P0 backlog). miguel can you file the runbook PR?

miguel: filing PR now: https://git.redwood/repo/runbooks/pull/482 (WIP).

shreya: posting incident summary to #incidents-postmortems and tagging CS for customer impact analysis. Summary: noisy tenant induced reserved pool saturation; autoscaler hit pool cap; mitigations: evicted low-priority sessions, applied per-tenant rate-limits, added +2 hot nodes from flex, reduced queue and throttles. Customer impact: transient 5-10 minutes degraded throughput for multiple tenants; Northbridge saw brief 5xx/429s, now recovered.

ops-bot: Incident severity: SEV3 -> recommended Postmortem? suggested owners: sam-platform (capacity flow), miguel (runbook), shreya (detection rule), tara-cs (customer follow-up).

oncall-sre: thanks everyone. I'll close this thread once postmortem ticket created. If anything regresses, re-open pager. :thumbsup:

miguel: noted — created INC-2026-3789 for the postmortem and linked runbook PR.

tara-cs: CS follow-up scheduled with Northbridge for impact review tomorrow 10:00am PT.

shreya: adding metrics graphs and flame charts to the incident ticket.

ops-bot: thread archived metrics snapshot: https://telemetry.redwood/internal/snapshots/3778884444
